correctness.rationale: The root-reachability order on Hamming products is exactly coordinatewise activation from the root. Chain cover is equivalent to rooted geodesic cover by a direct chain embedding plus Dilworth. On a shortest path, incomparability between chronologically ordered points requires a replacement or both an addition and erasure. Disjoint antichain intervals can be charged at most h+min(e,a) times. An explicit order of coordinate changes attains the bound. Optimizing over endpoints proves 1+t+floor(b/2) at every root. The two independently organized exhaustive Python programs corroborate small cases and terminalwise maxima but are not substitutes for the proof.
